The '''Elshandruu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Elshandruu Pica]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sair Yonka]] and the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Freedom|''Avarice'']] went to the Elshandruu system and fought the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt]].<ref name="XW:TBW" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' was stationed in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="I,J">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
